title: Fully open short
pitch: A short made only from permissively licensed weights: Klein, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step.
why: The whole chain is commercial-friendly by licence, with no revenue caps or territory terms: the clean baseline for anything you want to sell.

fields.label: The world
fields.default: a jungle temple at dawn, gold light through mist

models.name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Base (flux-2-klein-base-4b, qwen_3_4b text encoder, flux2-vae)
models.licence: Apache-2.0: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 repository says "4B models are Apache 2.0" and "The autoencoder is released under Apache 2.0"; Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Klein-4B, the download, is tagged apache-2.0; Qwen/Qwen3-4B is tagged apache-2.0. Checked 2026-11-01.

models.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B (wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16, umt5_xxl text encoder, wan2.2_vae)
models.licence: Apache-2.0: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B says "The models in this repository are licensed under the Apache 2.0 License"; Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged is tagged apache-2.0. Checked 2026-11-01.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo (acestep_v1.5_xl_turbo_bf16, qwen_0.6b_ace15, qwen_4b_ace15, ace_1.5_vae)
models.licence: MIT: ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-turbo and ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 are tagged mit; Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files, the download, is tagged apache-2.0. Both are permissive. Checked 2026-11-01.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Wan 2.2 5B runs in less memory than H3 or LTX.
Klein's 9B models are not open: this chain stays on 4B on purpose.

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

tested.note: Klein 4B stills, Wan 2.2 5B moves and an ACE-Step score, every weight Apache-2.0 or MIT. Frames checked at 3 per second: stairs in mist, a carved stone face, a stone arch over the canopy at sunrise, no people, no text. The first move is gentle; the camera glide is small. Sound measured at -13.3 LUFS, not judged by ear.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Still 1
raw_steps.prompt: Wide cinematic still of {world}, overgrown stone stairs. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Still 2
raw_steps.prompt: Close cinematic still of a carved stone face covered in moss in {world}. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Still 3
raw_steps.prompt: Wide cinematic still of the highest terrace of {world}, a great stone archway open to the rising sun above a sea of jungle canopy. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Move 1
raw_steps.prompt: Mist drifts slowly across the empty stone stairs and the camera glides forward. Nobody is there, only the stone, the leaves and the light.

raw_steps.label: Move 2
raw_steps.prompt: Light slides across the stone and leaves fall slowly.

raw_steps.label: Move 3
raw_steps.prompt: Sunlight widens through the archway, mist rolls slowly over the canopy far below and birds cross the distance.
